content.name: Extreme Cold
entries: When the temperature is 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower, a creature exposed to the extreme cold must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw at the end of each hour or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level. Creatures that have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} or {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Cold damage automatically succeed on the save.
